name: elm-m3e
description: M3e.* — type-safe Make-Impossible-States-Impossible Elm layer over the @m3e/web Material 3 Expressive web components (introspectable IR + phantom-typed slots).

scripts.gen:src: PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" node "${ELM_CEM_BIN:-../elm-cem/bin/elm-cem.js}" --flags-from=docs/node_modules/@m3e/web/dist/custom-elements.json --config-from=config/slots.json --config-from=config/native-mdn.json --config-from=config/examples.generated.json --output=src && npm run format:src && npm run format:icons && npm run format:families
scripts.test:fast: run-p test:elm test:examples-gen test:samples-gen test:roundtrip test:icons-gen test:search-index-gen
scripts.check:spike: cd tests/spike && ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make app/ApiConsolidation.elm --output=/dev/null && ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make app/AnnotationOnly.elm --output=/dev/null && ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make app/IconUse.elm --output=/dev/null && ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make app/SlotPlacersOk.elm --output=/dev/null && ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make app/EnumNarrowingOk.elm --output=/dev/null && ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make app/SlotApiOk.elm --output=/dev/null && ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make bad/SlotPlacersWrongKind.elm --output=/dev/null && ! ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make bad/WrongKindBuilderIntoIconSlot.elm --output=/dev/null 2>/dev/null && ! ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make bad/EnumNarrowingSplitButton.elm --output=/dev/null 2>/dev/null && ! ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make bad/EnumNarrowingBuilder.elm --output=/dev/null 2>/dev/null && ! ../../node_modules/.bin/elm make bad/SlotApiWrongKind.elm --output=/dev/null 2>/dev/null
